command_name.description: Name of the skill or command that is loading, such as pr-summary, or my-plugin:deploy for a plugin's skill.

command_source.description: Where the skill or command comes from. Open string: the examples are the documented values, and the Agent SDK types the field optional.

level.description: Open string: the Agent SDK types it as string; the examples are the documented levels.

invoked_by.description: user when the user typed the skill's name or an Agent SDK app sent it; claude when Claude or a session-scoped scheduled task invoked the skill; other for anything else, such as a subagent that preloads the skill. Open string: an unrecognized value must be treated as other.

permission_mode.description: Open string: the Agent SDK types it as string; the examples are the documented modes.

scratchpad_dir.description: Session scratchpad directory; absent when the session has none or the temp directory is unavailable (Claude Code v2.1.257 or later).

command.description: The shell command as it would run, with arguments filled in.

tool_name.description: The tool that runs the command, Bash or PowerShell.

tool_use_id.description: ID of this command; it names no tool call in the transcript.
